selection.cells: region x frozen-rule result (accepted/rejected) x model decision (suggest/review) = 8 cells
selection.fill_rule: if fewer than `minimum` cases were chosen, append remaining pool rows by (priority, case_id) until `minimum`; never more than `maximum`
selection.not_a_benchmark: curated examples are chosen to show behaviour, not to measure it; every measured number on the page comes from the TEST evaluation, never from these rows
selection.ordering_within_cell: priority 0 = adjudicated label disagrees with the model decision; 1 = adjudicated label agrees; 2 = INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; 3 = unlabelled; ties broken by case_id ascending
selection.pool: labelled cases in the validation and test splits (never train, so no example is a memorised training row) plus the first 2000 unlabelled test-split cases by case_id
selection.scores: read from the batch predictions ml/data/predictions/<release_id>.parquet written by score-batch, which is the same predict_cases the live API calls
